summary: Tested Booking.com reviews showcase end-to-end (mobile 390x844). Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (public filtering of hidden reviews, admin 401 without token, id assignment & id preservation, rating 1-5 / score 0-10 / count>=0 validation 422, booking_url kept when no visible reviews). Frontend: Home section renders title/subtitle (EN), score pill '8,8' + 4.5 stars + '49 reviews on Booking.com', 2 cards with avatar initial, name, flag+country, stars, quoted text, 'Review published on Booking.com'; next/prev arrows and dots move carousel and update active dot; CTA opens Booking URL (redirects to hotel page). Empty state: no cards/arrows, score pill + CTA still shown. Admin: login -> tile 'tile-Recensioni Booking' -> /admin/booking-reviews loads values; edited score 9,1 / count 50, added review (name/flag/country/3 stars/text), moved up, saved (toast) -> public API and Home reflect changes in correct order; toggling visible off + save removes it from Home; client validation toasts for score 12 and empty name; delete removes card. State restored exactly (verified JSON identical to pre-test backup).

issues: Prev/next arrows (absolute, left:0/right:0) overlap the card edges and partially sit over the quoted text area on mobile; consider placing them outside card or adding horizontal padding to card text
Switch 'Mostra in vetrina' ON state shows brown track with teal thumb (thumbColor not set) - slightly inconsistent with brand

action_items: Optional: on web, ScrollView onMomentumScrollEnd/onScrollEndDrag may not fire for trackpad/touch swipes, so active dot/idx can go stale after manual swipe; consider onScroll with scrollEventThrottle
Optional: admin review_count parseInt('abc') silently becomes 0; validate count input
Optional: admin login form does not submit on Enter key (pre-existing)
